Choose an events CSV or a complete Yearwheel JSON backup.

CSV columns: name, category, subcategory, start, end, color, notes. Only name is required. Start/end accept ISO week numbers or YYYY-MM-DD dates. End week is inclusive; blank end means the start week. Blank start/end keeps an event unscheduled. Quoted names can contain line breaks. Set the wheel to the dates’ ISO year first. Colour: standard name, hex, or blank to inherit the category/subcategory event colour. Legacy highlight values also use the event colour. Legacy date, end_date and duration_weeks headers still work.
